description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'EmployeeSubordinateModelTest' that tests the functionality of the 'EmployeeSubordinateModel' class within the OrangeHRM project. The test verifies the output of the 'toArray' method by setting up Employee, ReportingMethod, and ReportTo entities, and checking if the model correctly serializes data into an array.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateModelTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the correct behavior of EmployeeSubordinateModel's toArray method.

methods.name: testToArray
methods.description: Unit test that constructs Employee, ReportingMethod, and ReportTo objects, then verifies that EmployeeSubordinateModel's toArray method serializes the data into the expected array format.
